description: The qwen rule with Qwen3.5's numbers (patch 16, merge 2, 65,536 to 16,777,216 pixels): sizes rounded to multiples of 32 half to even (1040 × 528 is 32.5 × 16.5 blocks: 32 × 16, where rounding half up would give 33 × 17), scaled into the pixel range (small pictures up to 65,536 pixels); refused (null) past an aspect ratio of 200.
